The Staff Selection Commission has announced the SSC CPO 2026 result on the official website. The result is released in the form of a PDF separately for male, female, and departmental candidates of the Delhi Police. Applicants can download the result PDF to check their qualifying status. The details provided in the SSC CPO result PDF are candidate name, roll number, father’s name, mother’s name, category, and others. As per the write-up, 48,615 applicants are shortlisted for the SSC CPO exam. The exam authorities will release the SSC CPO scorecard 2026 separately in the login window. Applicants need to provide their registration number and password to check the scorecard PDF. Check the result PDF and details mentioned and other details here.

SSC CPO Result 2026 Out @ssc.gov.in

The Staff Selection Commission has released the result of SSC CPO 2026 at ssc.gov.in. Candidates can download the result PDF. Applicants are not required to provide any login credentials to check the CPO result. The result can be checked by roll number, candidate name, father’s name, or mother’s name. Aspirants should keep the result PDF safe for future reference.

SSC CPO Paper 1 Result 2026: Overview

A total of 3709 vacancies are announced for the recruitment of applicants in central police departments. Applicants shortlisted based on the performance in the exam now have to appear for the Physical Endurance Test (PET)/Physical Standard Test (PST). Check the table provided below for complete details.

SSC CPO Result Download Link

The Staff Selection Commission has activated the direct link to download the result PDF. Applicants who appeared can download the SSC CPO result to check their qualifying status. A total of 48,615 aspirants are declared qualified based on the performance in the written exam. Applicants are advised to keep the result PDF safe till the conclusion of the recruitment. The result PDF is released separately for male, female, and departmental candidates of the Delhi Police. Check the direct link to download the result PDF from the table below.

Result PDF Download result link
List of female candidates qualified in Paper-I Download PDF
List of male candidates qualified in Paper-I Download PDF
List of departmental candidates of Delhi Police Qualified in Paper-I Download PDF

How To Download SSC CPO Merit List PDF

The exam authority has announced the SSC CPO 2026 result on the official website. Applicants can download the result PDF. Candidates can check the step-by-step guide to access the result PDF below.

  • Visit the SSC official website at ssc.gov.in.
  • Click on the “Results” tab on the homepage.
  • Now navigate to the “CAPF” exam from the list of available ones.
  • Check all the details mentioned in the result.
  • Download the result PDF for lists 1, 2, and 3 for future reference.

ssc.gov.in SSC CPO Result Live Updates

The SCC CPO Result 2026 has been released for Paper 1 exam on the official website. Candidates can check the live updates related to SSC CPO 2026 result from below.

What happens after clearing SSC CPO PET/PST stage?

Candidates who qualify PET/PST will be called for Paper 2 examination. This is a descriptive/English language-based paper. Performance in Paper 2 plays an important role in final selection.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 08:30:55 PM IST

What is SSC CPO Vacancy 2025?

The Staff Selection Commission has announced 5308 Sub Inspector posts in Delhi Police and CAPFs. Candidates can refer to the official notification for exact category-wise vacancy details.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 08:00:18 PM IST

What is SSC CPO PET/PST Syllabus?

Candidates who qualify Paper 1 and Paper 2 are called to appear for the SSC CPO Physical test. As per the Physical Test pattern, the evaluation will be conducted in two parts: Physical Efficiency Test and Physical Standard Test.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 07:30:34 PM IST

My name is in the SSC CPO Result PDF, what to do next?

Candidates who cleared Paper 1 should start preparing for PET/PST immediately. They should also keep their documents ready for verification. Early preparation can improve chances of clearing the physical tests.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 07:00:22 PM IST

Is SSC CPO Cut Off 2026 also released?

Yes, the Staff Selection Commission has released category wise cut-off marks along with the SSC CPO result PDF. Candidates can check the category wise cut off and qualifying marks from the PDF.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 06:45:49 PM IST

What Should I do if I cannot find my name in SSC CPO result 2026?

If your name is not on the list, it means you did not reach the cut-off marks this time. Do not worry! You can check the final answer key and your marks once they are released.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 06:30:27 PM IST

When was the SSC CPO Paper 1 exam 2025 held?

The SSC CPO 2025 computer-based test for Paper 1 was conducted from 9th to 12 December 2025. Candidates who appeared in the paper 1 exam can now check their qualification status for PET/PST stage

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 06:15:32 PM IST

What details are mentioned in the SSC CPO result PDF?

The SSC CPO Paper 1 result PDF includes important information such as candidate roll number, name, category and details regarding the next stage in selection process.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 06:00:57 PM IST

What is the next stage after passing SSC CPO Paper 1 Exam 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the SSC CPO Paper 1 will be called for the next round i.e. Physical Endurance Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST).

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 05:45:46 PM IST

How do I find my name in the result PDF?

Candidates can follow these simple steps to check their qualification status:

  1. Open the result PDF from the website.
  2. Use the ‘Find’ tool by pressing Ctrl+F. 
  3. Type your roll number or full name to check your status.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 05:30:40 PM IST

How many students passed the SSC CPO Paper 1 exam?

A total of 48,615 candidates have successfully passed the Paper 1 exam this year for SSC CPO Recruitment. These students will be called for the next round, i.e., PET/PST.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 05:15:04 PM IST

Where can I check my SSC CPO result 2026?

Candidates can check the SSC CPO result from the official website at ssc.gov.in. All they have to do is visit the official website and click on the ‘Results’ tab and then select the ‘CAPF’ link to find the latest notification.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 05:00:10 PM IST

Is the SSC CPO Paper 1 Result 2026 Out today?

The Staff Selection Commission has officially released the Paper 1 result on 30th March 2026. Candidates can now download the result for Delhi Police and CAPFs from ssc.gov.in to check the qualification status.

Updated on: 30 Mar 2026 | 04:45:35 PM IST

Details Mentioned on SSC CPO Result 2026

After downloading the result PDF, applicants are advised to check all the details mentioned in it. In case of any mistake in the result, applicants are advised to contact the exam authorities for corrections. The information provided in the SSC CPO result PDF is provided below.

  • Roll numbers of shortlisted candidates
  • Name of candidate
  • Father’s name
  • Mother’s name
  • Gender
  • Category

SSC CPO Cut Off 2026

The Staff Selection Commission has released the SSC CPO 2026 cut off marks on the official website. Applicants who appeared in the exam can now check the cut off. The exam authority has released the cutoff separately for all the categories. Applicants who score marks equal to or more than the cutoff are declared shortlisted for the next stage of the recruitment process. SSC CPO Result 2026 FAQs

Q1: When will the SSC CPO result 2026 be released?

Answer: The exam authority released the CPO result on 30th March at the official website.

Q2: How many candidates are declared shortlisted based on the SSC CPO result 2026?

Answer: A total of 48,615 applicants are declared shortlisted for the Physical Endurance Test (PET)/Physical Standard Test (PST).

Q3: In what mode is the SSC CPO result 2026 released?

Answer: The exam authority has released the results in the form of a PDF, comprising details of all the shortlisted candidates.

Q4: How can I check SSC CPO cut off 2026?

Answer: The exam authority has released the cut off marks on the official website.
